knowledge_gaps: The proposed uniform control is not the original IID uniform K=16 sampler. Resampling 16 slots from one shared 64-item pool preserves uniform marginal probabilities but introduces dependence and extra duplicates, changing expected candidate CE. Retain a direct-IID uniform control or explicitly identify the pool-resampling intervention.

The curriculum changes both hardness and training stage. Uniform versus curriculum CE measures their combined effect; it does not establish that gradual introduction beats constant moderate-hard sampling. Prioritize establishing the original uniform-CE result before adding this factor.

Ranks 9–32 within a 64-draw pool do not guarantee moderate difficulty. Record score gaps, distinct candidate counts, repeated-item multiplicity and selected-rank distributions. Full-history exclusion reduces known-positive contamination but cannot establish negative validity.

Consumed-record replay needs detached scores for all 64 pool entries, stable ranking indices, curriculum probability and selected slot indices. Seeds and selected-negative logits alone cannot independently verify model-dependent selection without reproducing historical parameters and forward randomness. Adapt the existing audit beyond its documented seeded uniform-negative checks.

Implementation remains incomplete: define the eligible-item sampler, empty-batch behavior, reduction after skipped targets, diagnostic batch limit, capture timing and fresh-process parity runner. Use no_grad for mining scores; detaching features alone can still construct a graph through item embeddings. Verify matching corrupted inputs across controls.

No concrete remaining GPU allocation, completion-cost estimate, validation schedule or tie rule is supplied. The report also omits paired uncertainty reporting when host user-level hits are available. With only 200 validation users per category, additional adaptive comparisons increase selection risk.

Originality 3 is reasonable for an established sampling adaptation. Future potential 7 remains speculative, and difficulty 4 may understate custom replay and predictor integration. Semantic and temporal alternatives need no immediate promotion: the current evidence supports repairing observation coverage and completing the simpler controlled experiment first.
